data.body: **[P1] Keep PR-authored workflows off the account runner.** A `pull_request` uses the PR's workflow definition, so a fork can alter this expression—or the gates in the other migrated workflows—to request the predictable CodeBuild label. Once approved, arbitrary PR code can access the CodeBuild job's ambient AWS role and network context; Dependabot PRs also select CodeBuild because their head repository equals the base repository. Route privileged runs through a base-controlled dispatcher that verifies a same-repository, non-bot head, and enforce that restriction in the CodeBuild webhook/project policy.
